payload.name: pc-check-weighted-entries
payload.description: Raw validator that inspects a candidate list of weighted entries and returns an explicit invalid-result object (ok=false, entries=[]) for missing, null, wrong-typed or out-of-range data, without raising or coercing. A boolean is not an integer; extra item fields fail closed. An empty list is a valid selection. Typed inputs are a target interface, not deployed runtime support; this is an unapproved draft.
